name: IndieAI

sources.title: IndieAI homepage — includes full submission pricing table

conditions: Free $0 submission requires badge verification — the IndieAI badge must stay on your site permanently; they 'check regularly & unpublish if removed'
Free listings are 'Reviewed within 30 days' and include no customer support
requirements: AI tools built by indie developers (site's stated curation focus)
Badge embed required for the free tier
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, AI category (AI Image Generation, AI Coding, AI Productivity, etc.)
Pricing model label (Free/Freemium/Paid/Free Trial style used across listings)
Badge placed on the site for the free route; otherwise pick Fast Track $19 / Premium $39 / Unlimited $69
workflow: Click Submit in nav → choose a package on the pricing section
Free: 'Get Started' → submit details → place badge → wait up to 30 days for review
Paid: 'Submit Now' → pay one-time → 'Go live instantly' with permanent listing and no badge requirement
Premium adds 7 days homepage featured; Unlimited adds top banner + site-wide exposure for 7 days + blog post opportunity
watchFor: The free badge is checked on an ongoing basis, not once — removing it later gets the listing unpublished
Fast Track ($19) explicitly has 'No featured placement' — homepage exposure needs Premium ($39) or Unlimited ($69)
All paid tiers are one-time payments; do not confuse 'Featured on homepage for 7 days' with permanent placement
countsAsLive: Tool page reachable under indieai.directory and the tool listed in its category/Latest AI Tools section
unknowns: Exact badge markup and verification method
Account requirement for submission (not stated on the homepage pricing block)
